tagline: Blocks. Spaceships. A whole universe to explore.
short_description: A 3D space crafting adventure for explorers and builders. Command your own ship across procedurally generated planets, mine rare resources, uncover the mysteries of the VEGA protocol, and build massive bases alone or with your friends. Free, open source, in 14 languages.
long_description:
A 3D space crafting adventure for explorers and builders. Command your own ship across procedurally generated planets, mine rare resources, uncover the mysteries of the VEGA protocol, and build massive bases alone or with your friends.

Blocks Beyond the Stars is not a traditional indie game - it is an exploration of what is possible with Generative AI today. It was created by a father and his 10-year-old son:

  • Justus (10) is the "Lead Product Manager". He imagines the universe, requests features (from corrupted planets to hover speeders), and acts as the strict lead playtester.
  • Marcel (Dad) uses his professional software engineering background to prompt, orchestrate, and integrate those ideas using modern AI tools.
  • Verena (Mom) handles the game balancing and tests the multiplayer.

100% of the assets in this game were created using AI. The game is fully playable in 14 languages (English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Turkish, Dutch, Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese) and grows with free updates several times a week - open the "What's new?" panel in the main menu to see the latest.

The whole journey - how a 10-year-old's dream became a real game, built entirely with AI - is also a book and audiobook (German and English), and a daily AI-generated dev podcast recaps every change: see the project website.

We are currently looking for support with our open-source project.

https://www.blocksbeyondthestars.com/
gameplay_mechanics:
Mine, craft and build: every planet is fully destructible and rebuildable, block by block. Gather resources, craft tools and machines, and grow your first camp into a homestead with beds, campfires, furniture, power, lights, teleporters, factories and vehicles - seal your rooms and they hold air.

Your spaceship is the heart of the loop: take off from the surface, fly through open space in first person, go on EVA spacewalks and land on any planet you can reach. Fly one of the ready-made ships or build your own on the ground, keel to commissioning. Survival systems - oxygen, energy, hunger, temperature, day/night, weather with real wind and per-planet gravity - keep exploration tense, while creatures can be fought or tamed to travel alongside you and bandits ambush you on foot and in space.

Make it yours: rotate blocks, design your own block shapes, paint your walls, and dress your astronaut with a 32x32 pixel editor and up to eight saved outfits. Built-in editors let you design ships, avatars, stations and towns and bring them into your worlds.
narrative_setting:
You are a lone pilot in a procedurally generated galaxy, guided by VEGA, your ship's AI. What starts as simple survival slowly becomes a mystery: who created the VEGA protocol, and why? Story fragments, villages, monuments left by those who came before, and hidden treasures scattered across the planets fill in the picture.

Every world type has its own character: scorching lava planets, frozen wastes, overgrown jungles, deep oceans with real continents, crystal caves, fungal forests, ringed giants, asteroid belts and floating skylands.
visual_audio_style:
A colorful, readable voxel aesthetic with modern lighting: dynamic day/night cycles with twilight and golden hour, weather episodes and alien skies, fog and a distinct palette for every biome, framed by a clean sci-fi holographic UI.

An original soundtrack, a voiced ship AI and atmospheric sound design accompany mining, flight and exploration - every generated creature species even gets its own voice. The game is fully localized in 14 languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Turkish, Dutch, Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese.
multiplayer_options: Online co-op for 2-12 players: private, password-gated worlds for friends and family (with in-game voice chat and player-to-player trading), plus shared arcade worlds here on Glitch (up to 8 players per world). Singleplayer runs entirely in your browser.
dlc_expansion_info: No DLC and no in-app purchases - the game is free and open source. New content and features arrive as free updates several times a week; the in-game "What's new?" panel lists them.
system_requirements: Browser: any modern desktop browser with WebGL2 (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari). Mouse and keyboard recommended; Xbox-style gamepads and touch controls (tablets and phones) are fully supported. Native builds for Windows, macOS and Linux are available on the project website; 8 GB RAM recommended.
key_features:
• Fly your own ship between procedurally generated block planets - lava, ice, ocean, jungle, desert, crystal, fungal and floating skylands, with continents, canyons, cave tunnels, ringed planets and asteroid belts
  • Fully destructible worlds: mine every block, build anywhere - rotate blocks, design your own shapes, paint your walls
  • Build your own spaceship in-world, or fly one of the ready-made designs
  • Survival systems: oxygen, energy, hunger, temperature, day/night, weather with wind and per-planet gravity
  • Uncover the mystery of the VEGA protocol with your voiced ship AI
  • Tame creatures, fight bandits, hunt bounties and hidden treasures
  • Homestead: beds, campfires, furniture, sealed rooms that hold air, greenhouses and factories
  • Pixel-paint your astronaut and save up to eight outfits; in-game editors for ships, avatars, stations and towns
  • Play solo in the browser or co-op with up to 12 players - trade with other players, keyboard, gamepad and touch
  • Free, open source, playable in 14 languages
